How we work

A clear purpose. An agreed role. A practical way forward.

You can begin with a specific question, an opportunity or a business challenge. Together, we define the work, the contribution SetuHashi will make and how we will assess progress.

Clear interests and responsibilities

Know whom we represent—and what each participant undertakes.

  • When you commission us

    We work under your mandate and disclose relevant relationships or interests, including any interest in follow-on work.

  • When we represent a supplier

    We tell the buyers we approach whom we represent. Any success fee is also disclosed.

  • When we develop something jointly

    Contributions, decision rights, commercial interests and responsibilities are agreed among the participants.

  • When interests could conflict

    We make the conflict visible and agree on how it will be managed. Where it cannot be managed appropriately, we arrange independent review or refer the work elsewhere.

  • Where specialists are needed

    Legal, tax, regulated financial and investment advice, and employment and immigration matters are handled by appropriately qualified specialists.

A further safeguard

We do not assess options for a buyer in a pursuit where we already represent a supplier, unless all parties are informed and agree to the terms.

You retain your decisions. Customers, partners and financiers retain theirs. Each participant remains responsible for its own work.
